generated.what_happened: UAE prosecutors revealed that flydubai co-pilot Hammam al-Hammami attempted to execute a suicide attack by crashing a Dubai-to-Tel Aviv passenger jet into Ben Gurion Airport's passenger terminal. During the flight, al-Hammami attacked the plane's captain with an emergency axe, but the injured captain managed to open the cockpit door, allowing passengers to intervene and overpower the assailant. An off-duty relief pilot on board safely landed the aircraft in Saudi Arabia after it sharply plunged during the struggle. According to authorities, al-Hammami confessed to acting alone and was inspired by the September 11 terrorist attacks, prompting international investigations into how he cleared security vetting.
